_comment: Sprint I3 T3 — non-lexical fillers hidden from a conversation's displayed transcript, per language, lower-cased. raw_text keeps every word; hidden words keep their timings. nlp-service (stages/disfluency.py) asserts its table equals this file, and the notes scorer (scripts/eval/_textrules.normalise_quote) carries the same list, so a quote taken from the displayed text still matches the raw one.
